scope: Blinded explicit-target PDP classification over the sealed Phase-A panel; no oracle labels, relation collection, discrete-log recovery, or key material enter solver execution
claim_boundary: This phase can measure three SAT backends on a balanced public toy PDP panel. It cannot establish natural decomposability prevalence, an end-to-end index-calculus result, private-key recovery, or a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA claim.

solver_root.access_boundary: The solver driver receives this sanitized root only. The Phase-A oracle ledger and raw seal are withheld until the separately invoked scoring step.

execution.instance_order: the authenticated blind bundle presentation order
execution.output_policy: new output root, write-once task artifacts, no resume, terminal inventory seal

wdsat_build.sizing_boundary: The complete 160-instance export-only pass measured max_buffer_size 32804, which this additive successor freezes exactly. All other WDSat limits and Phase-B fields remain unchanged.
wdsat_build.undersized_action: Seal the export-only sizing artifact as inconclusive, run no solver, and freeze an additive larger-config successor.

rust_release_build.scope: Fresh metered release build of the explicit-target exporter and isolated backend plus source and binary identities

cryptominisat_build.scope: Fresh metered clean source copy, configure, and single-build receipt plus binary identity

tool_build_accounting.effect: A Phase-B solver panel may be an internal engineering measurement, but cannot pass the full-cost or SOTA gate until additive build receipts are frozen and bound.

accounting.meter: scripts/process_meter.py in a fresh process for every exporter, solver, and point-witness validator
accounting.wdsat_build_cost: A production execution manifest must bind a compatible WDSat executable and its separately charged build receipt; build cost is not hidden in per-target solver time.

scoring.rule: The solver run must be terminally sealed before the scorer is given the raw Phase-A seal and oracle ledger.

solver_phase: The sanitized solver root contains exactly the bound blind bundle and sanitized binding
Every exporter manifest is explicit-target v2 and matches its blind instance exactly
No forbidden oracle field, path, environment variable, or input reaches a child process
Every exporter, backend, and model validator has a fresh-process receipt
Unknown and timeout outcomes remain inconclusive
All 160 task records and 480 backend outcomes are covered by the terminal inventory seal
post_run: The scorer verifies the terminal run seal before opening the oracle
The raw Phase-A seal authenticates the oracle bytes
Scoring joins records only by the exact blind instance id and target
The scored artifact remains a balanced toy PDP result rather than an index-calculus or SOTA claim
